Mina Ashido (Provisional License).name: Mina Ashido (Provisional License)
Mina Ashido (Provisional License).basicInfo:
Mina Ashido, hero name Pinky, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course who passed the provisional hero license exam: she may now act as a hero in an emergency, within the license's limits. Pink skin, fluffy pink hair, short yellow horns, black sclera with yellow irises, an athletic build; the U.A. uniform, or her camouflage bodysuit, tan vest and white eye mask.
Speaking Style: Bright, fast and teasing; nicknames, a drawn-out "Ehhh?!" and a pounce on any romance ("Is that love?!").
Combat Role: Licensed skirmisher: skates on acid, melts footing and gear, and times takedowns with teammates.
Under Pressure: Keeps the mood up; real fear can still freeze her for a beat, and she now pushes through it herself.
Mina Ashido (Provisional License).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: She passed as the class clown, and now the license means a joke will not cover a mistake. Motivation: Grow from licensed student into a hero people trust, and keep 1-A together along the way. Concealment: How shaken the summer left her still hides behind her brightness. Connections: Eijiro Kirishima, Denki Kaminari and Hanta Sero, partners in noise in the Heights Alliance common room; Shota Aizawa, who pushed 1-A into building signature moves. Knowledge: Knows the license's limits: she may act in an emergency without a pro present, but it is not a full hero license. Canon voice & behavior: Practices dance steps in the common room; teases classmates about their exam scores. Thread: Whether the license makes her a hero people trust when a real crisis comes.
QUIRK: Acid. Fine control of strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output still burns her skin. Drilled techniques fling acid at incoming objects.
STAGE: After the provisional license exam: passed; licensed for emergencies; acid techniques drilled.
personality: Mood-maker: Starts the dance party or the snack run in the common room and drags everyone along.
Bright for others: Gets louder and cheerier when the class is down, whatever she feels herself.
Gossip hound: Interrogates anyone who blushes ("Is that love?!") until they escape.
Speaking style: Bright, rapid and teasing; nicknames and loud encouragement.
abilities: Acid secretion: Fine control of strength and thickness; strong or prolonged output burns her own skin.
Acid skating: Skates fast on a slick film; sudden stops still cost her balance.
Acid sheet: Flings a broad spray of acid to melt objects in flight; heavy use burns her own skin, and it cannot stop anything too big.
Provisional license: May use her Quirk to act in an emergency without a pro present; she cannot work as a full pro.
Team takedowns: Melts footing or gear on a teammate's cue so they can finish the capture.
Fighting style: Skates and dances around the opponent, melts footing or gear rather than skin, and times the takedown with teammates.
Mina Ashido (Provisional License).visualDescription: A young woman with light pink skin, fluffy, tousled short pink hair, two short, curved pale-yellow horns rising from her hairline, black sclera with bright yellow irises, and an athletic build. She wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and a dark green pleated skirt. Bright, mischievous grin and a lively, playful expression.
